# name: dg-me-probe-polar-det-test
# technique: test a claim no recipe certifies, at instances the kernel checks by computation (test_fallback)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Geometry.polar_det file "dg-me-probe-polar-det-test.sage"
# description: det (metricAt polar x) = r² at the chart points (0, 0) (edge), (2, 1), (1/2, 3), by unfolding the components.
SEED = 0
PROOF = 'norm_num [CoordinateGeometry.metricAt, KaluzaKlein.Geometry.polar, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]'
CASES = [(['![0, 0]'], True), (['![2, 1]'], False), (['![1 / 2, 3]'], False)]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=PROOF, edge=edge) for values, edge in CASES]

atoms: of fun i j => polar i j x

instances.reason: the block does not close the instance
the block does not close the instance
